focus_area: NTFS case-folding and path containment edge cases
prompt: Review ResourceLockManager.isSubpath() and normalizePath() for path traversal bugs (e.g. C:\foo and C:\foobar) and Windows short 8.3 filenames.
acceptance_criteria: Verify that trailing slashes prevent C:\foobar from being treated as subpath of C:\foo.

focus_area: Start-time tolerance window (2000ms) on high CPU load
prompt: Evaluate whether a 2000ms drift tolerance is optimal under heavy Windows paging or if high-resolution process creation timestamps from NtQueryInformationProcess should be used.
acceptance_criteria: Confirm that 2000ms prevents false PID recycling alarms while safely catching real recycling.

focus_area: SHA-256 disk streaming vs memory buffering
prompt: Verify that EvidenceVerifier streams files from disk using fs.createReadStream rather than readFileSync to prevent OOM on large artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Artifacts larger than 50MB verified without spike in Node heap usage.
